milestone: PR2 shared journal ownership and AppliedCommandLSN plumbing
durability_mode: command WAL execution remains format-gated; PR2 adds shared journal ownership, AppliedCommandLSN meta publication, read-only debt detection, and cleanup proof helpers
sync_policy: existing commit-log segment framing, writer flush/sync, and alternating meta-page publication are reused
command_kinds_touched: RawKVBatch typed frame append via shared CommandJournal
crash_scenarios: corrupt active meta page after root plus AppliedCommandLSN publish selects previous durable tuple
read-only open with complete LSN greater than AppliedCommandLSN returns ErrRecoveryRequired
read-write open skips complete typed frames whose max LSN is already covered by durable AppliedCommandLSN before legacy raw WAL replay
read-write open fails recovery-required on complete typed frames above durable AppliedCommandLSN until the PR3 dispatcher exists
read-write open fails recovery-required for the first typed command frame when durable AppliedCommandLSN is still zero
cleanup after AppliedCommandLSN only removes covered non-active typed command WAL segments

benchmark_summary.journal_owner_append_allocs_per_op: 0 allocs/op for shared journal LSN allocation plus RawKVBatch append
benchmark_summary.applied_lsn_publish_allocs_per_op: same 4 allocs/op and 160 B/op as baseline finalizeCommitSameRoots when caller supplies reusable coverage storage
benchmark_summary.applied_lsn_publish_latency: 913 ns/op median-ish benchstat center versus 867 ns/op for baseline finalizeCommitSameRoots in this smoke run
benchmark_summary.normal_write_path_scans: publish helper does not scan WAL, value-log, or root inventory; cleanup proof is a separate helper

known_gaps: production raw KV writes convert from legacy commitlog.Record batches to RawKVBatch command frames in PR3
typed recovery dispatcher and command replay idempotency land in PR3
collection command payloads and normal collection executor replay start in PR4
